forecasts.question: Will the Knesset pass the dissolution bill's final reading with a fixed election date earlier than 2026-10-27 before EOD 2026-07-15?
forecasts.delta_reason: Knesset Legal Adviser Sagit Afik recommended dissolution on July 17 — two days AFTER the F6 July 15 deadline; Knesset Speaker Ohana and Coalition Whip Katz publicly confirmed this timetable. As of July 10, no second or third readings had been scheduled before July 15.
